They executed commands to export Windows registry hives (SAM, SECURITY, SYSTEM) and compressed them into a ZIP file. - They used PowerShell and the reg utility as part of data collection and staging. - They conducted anti-forensics by deleting artifacts and running Cipher.exe to securely erase files. - They persisted and returned after initial activity, switching between compromised accounts when passwords changed or expired. -
